name: red-flag-scanner
description: Recon Red-Flag Scanner — a deterministic, browser-only checklist that ranks red flags in a landlord's operating-expense reconciliation. No AI in the arithmetic; no data leaves the browser.

scripts.build:single: cross-env SINGLE_FILE=1 vite build && node scripts/finalize-single.mjs && node scripts/build-gate.mjs dist-single
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
